summary: Payette NF crow's nest from the 1930s, listed as abandoned. One undated page says it is still there; the record's gone status is not supported.

facts.status_note: Listed as abandoned. One undated page says the crow's nest is still there; no visit or recent photo found.

evidence.supports: crow's nest dated to the 1930s and listed as abandoned in that decade
Kamstra's page says the crow's nest is still there; no date given for the check
Keeping Watch gives the same coordinates and points to Kamstra's page
Keeping Watch points readers to Rex Kamstra's Forest Fire Lookout page
evidence.quote: visit Rex Kamstra's Forest Fire Lookout page on this firetower

corrections.why: The Forest Fire Lookout Association list gives Abandoned, not gone. The idahofirelookouts.com page says Abandoned, not gone. firelookout.com says the crow's nest is 'Still there'. None of the three pages read says gone.

sources.title: Box Canyon Lookout
sources.publisher: Keeping Watch, Center for Digital Inquiry and Learning

notes_for_editor: The record's gone status comes from the Forest Fire Lookout Association list, which actually reads Abandoned; the brief's note that idahofirelookouts.com says gone does not match the page, which says Abandoned. Kamstra's 'Still there' has no date, and no recent photo or visit was found. Two web searches found nothing else. Holm's 2010 Payette fire lookout book is listed in the Idaho Bibliography Project but was not checked. Suggest a recent photo before any status is published. Record elevation and kind (platform) are consistent with the sources.
